Download **lazy-deck-0.5.4.streamDeckPlugin** below and double-click it. Stream Deck installs or updates the plugin along with its profiles.

- **New keys:** **Telegram** (launches the desktop app) and **Telegram Web** (opens it in your browser), right next to WhatsApp. Lazy Deck now has 109 keys.
- Still includes the **Stream Deck Neo info bar** from 0.5.3: Sam shows the time, the focus timer or what's waiting for you. Requires Stream Deck 7.6 or newer.
